title: The Cheap *Breach*
dek: A hacker breached 100+ companies with AI agents for a few thousand dollars. Microsoft released rogue-agent controls the same day.

stories.label: companies breached for a few thousand dollars via AI agents
stories.headline: The cost floor for sophisticated cyberattacks just moved.
The defender and the attacker are building with the same tools.

stories.label: OpenAI target valuation, up from $852B in March 2026
stories.headline: OpenAI is treating Anthropic's IPO as a competitive event.

stories.short: 50 GW of new data centers in 2027
stories.label: of new data center capacity expected to arrive in 2027 alone
stories.headline: AI infrastructure is now measured on the scale of national grids.

stories.label: cheaper than MiniMax's prior model, launched today alongside Mercury 3
stories.headline: Two models cut cost in the same 24-hour window.

stories.short: DHS bans DeepSeek from civilian IT
stories.headline: Banned from the systems it was already inside.
Copyright litigation against AI training goes continental.

still_signal: Deployment cost fell to thousands of dollars; build cost scaled to gigawatts; governance arrived after the breach. The DHS order banned technology already inside the systems it meant to protect.
